versions.content: Provide an application interface to change operation cycles states Description: Operation cycles handled by the diagnostic in AUTOSAR can be restarted by application. Rationale: Operation cycle state transitions are trigger conditions for event status management according to ISO 14229-1. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: [RS_Diag_04178] Use Case: Monitoring application restarts an operation cycle. This triggers some status changes for the relevant events.
